modes.auto: Device-aware quality with conservative unknown-hardware fallback

modes.off: Atmosphere layer removed; decorative ambient loops paused

adaptiveAtmosphereV322.engine: WebGL2 decorative fragment shaders > Canvas2D fallback > static CSS > Off
adaptiveAtmosphereV322.technicalBoundary: Analytic ray intersections and direct occlusion shadows on procedural decorative geometry, not full DOM ray tracing or hardware RTX

adaptiveAtmosphereV322.localStorage: One mode preference only. No analytics or external requests
adaptiveAtmosphereV322.visualReview: Required on real browsers and devices
